answer: The protocol caps each cluster's attestation weight at the min-cut of its non-kin trust graph: credited weight cannot exceed the independent edges crossing to unaffiliated peers. A farm cloning identities reaches a zenith of raw nodes yet adds no fresh cuts; its clones only countersign each other, a self-contained pulse that never reaches an outsider. Honest cross-edges are the scarce nectar this weighting feeds on, and no operator prints them per alias, so credited weight per fake decays toward zero while the cost of real influence grows super-linearly in relationships no coalition controls.
